# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers aboard, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free for anyone fresh out of hypersleep.[/italic]
## Berths and Kit - [bold]SWAP[/bold]: top bunk near engineering for any bunk further from the fusion plant hum. Will throw in a good pillow. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], a second pair of thermal socks. Hangar West is colder than the ship plans admit. - Assignments and civilian rules aboard are posted by command at [netlink="Civilian Guidance" link="command.govfor.mil/guidance"].
## Trade - [bold]KOOR CIGARETTES[/bold], one carton, unopened. Trade for real coffee grounds, not the vending machine kind. - [bold]FLIGHT JACKET[/bold], pilot cut, worn at the elbows, name tape removed. Two packets of NutriCo bars or one of your galley shifts. - [bold]HAIRCUTS[/bold] in the washroom after second shift. Bring your own towel. Results not guaranteed in rough transit.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: one clicky pen, sentimental value, last seen in the Commander's Office. No questions asked. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a photograph of a family on a beach, left in a hypersleep pod. Collect it from the correspondent.
## Notices - Whoever keeps resetting the galley clock to Earth time: the night shift would like a word. - Hangar crews remind everyone that the cargo lift does not stop for people standing on it.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
